title: FeeInfo
description: Fee and limit details for a single asset. For crypto assets, `withdraw` and `deposit` are flat fee objects. For fiat assets with providers, they are objects keyed by provider ID.

providers.description: Payment provider identifiers used as the network parameter value for fiat deposits and withdrawals via the API. See GET /api/v4/public/assets providers field for context.

deposit.description: Deposit fee details. For crypto assets, this is a flat object with `max_amount`, `min_amount`, `fixed`, and `flex` fields. For fiat assets with providers, this is an object keyed by provider ID, where each value contains provider-specific fee details.

oneOf.description: Map of provider IDs to provider-specific deposit fee details

withdraw.description: Withdrawal fee details. For crypto assets, this is a flat object with `max_amount`, `min_amount`, `fixed`, and `flex` fields. For fiat assets with providers, this is an object keyed by provider ID, where each value contains provider-specific fee details.

oneOf.description: Map of provider IDs to provider-specific withdrawal fee details

is_depositable.description: Indicates whether deposits are enabled for the currency. May be absent from the response; absence should be treated as equivalent to false.

is_withdrawal.description: Indicates whether withdrawals are enabled for the currency. May be absent from the response; absence should be treated as equivalent to false.

FeeDetails.description: Fee amounts and transfer limits for a crypto asset

max_amount.description: Maximum transaction amount for the operation and network. May be absent independently from other limit fields; absence typically indicates no upper limit applies.

min_amount.description: Minimum transaction amount for the operation and network. May be absent independently from other limit fields.

fixed.description: Fixed fee amount per transaction. `null` if no fixed fee applies.

flex.description: Percentage-based (flexible) fee. `null` if no flexible fee applies.

min_fee.description: Minimum fee amount regardless of percentage calculation

max_fee.description: Maximum fee amount regardless of percentage calculation

ProviderFeeDetails.description: Fee details for a specific fiat payment provider

is_depositable.description: Whether deposits are enabled via this provider

is_api_depositable.description: Whether API deposits are enabled via this provider

is_withdrawal.description: Whether withdrawals are enabled via this provider

is_api_withdrawal.description: Whether API withdrawals are enabled via this provider

fixed.description: Fixed fee amount per transaction. `null` if no fixed fee applies.

flex.description: Percentage-based (flexible) fee. `null` if no flexible fee applies.

min_fee.description: Minimum fee amount regardless of percentage calculation

max_fee.description: Maximum fee amount regardless of percentage calculation
